tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's profile: role (student, institute or company), name, APAAR ID, institute/company name and account status.

tools.name: list_my_credentials
tools.title: List my credentials
tools.description: List academic credentials visible to the signed-in user. Students see credentials issued to them; institutes see credentials they issued.

limit.description: Maximum number of credentials to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_credential
tools.title: Get credential details
tools.description: Fetch the full details of one credential by its ID, including verification status. Only credentials the signed-in user may access are returned.

tools.name: list_credential_requests
tools.title: List credential requests
tools.description: List credential issuance requests visible to the signed-in user. Students see their own requests; institutes see requests addressed to them.

status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. pending, approved or rejected.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return (default 20).

tools.name: create_credential_request
tools.title: Request a credential
tools.description: Create a credential issuance request from the signed-in student to an institute. The institute reviews and approves it in the app.

issuer_id.description: User ID of the institute the request is sent to.

title.description: Title of the requested credential, e.g. 'B.Tech Degree Certificate'.

credential_type.description: Type of credential, e.g. degree, diploma, certificate.

roll_number.description: The student's roll number at the institute.

tools.name: list_institutes
tools.title: List institutes
tools.description: List institutes registered on the platform, with their user IDs — use these IDs as issuer_id when creating a credential request.

limit.description: Maximum number of institutes to return (default 25).
